root.name: コインベース・グローバル

companies.name: サークル・インターネット・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: 2018年に提携してUSDCを立ち上げ、発行はサークルが担っている
relations.text_en: They partnered in 2018 to launch USDC, which Circle issues

source.label: コインベース・グローバル 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2018, we partnered with Circle Internet Financial, LLC (“Circle”) to launch USDC, with the goal of driving global, mainstream adoption of stablecoins

relations.text: サークル合意に基づき、USDCの流通に応じてサークルから支払いを受ける
relations.text_en: Under the Circle Agreement, Circle pays Coinbase based on USDC in circulation

source.label: コインベース・グローバル 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Pursuant to the Circle Agreement, Circle is the issuer of USDC, holds the relevant trademarks which we can use, and pays us for our role in the growth of USDC

relations.text: Google Playストアは、アプリの主な配信経路のひとつである
relations.text_en: Google Play is one of the main distribution channels for its apps

source.label: コインベース・グローバル 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The Google Play Store and Apple App Store are global application distribution platforms and the main distribution channels for our apps

relations.text: Apple App Storeは、アプリの主な配信経路のひとつである
relations.text_en: The Apple App Store is one of the main distribution channels for its apps

source.label: コインベース・グローバル 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The Google Play Store and Apple App Store are global application distribution platforms and the main distribution channels for our apps

companies.name: ライオット・プラットフォームズ

relations.text: 保有する暗号資産の保管先としてコインベースを利用
relations.text_en: Uses Coinbase to store its digital assets

source.label: Riot Platforms 10-K
source.quote: NYDIG and Coinbase safely store our digital assets in segregated accounts

relations.text: 保管サービスの契約をコインベースと結ぶ
relations.text_en: Has a custody agreement with Coinbase

source.label: CleanSpark 10-K
source.quote: Our custody agreement with Coinbase provides that Coinbase will obtain and maintain at its sole expense insurance coverage

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
